decisions.what: Inputs (36 cases from Liu Hao's Astro-project requests) and grading method treated as approved
decisions.why: Brief from overseer-astronomy: Liu Hao asleep, 'emphatically do not ask me for feedback'; guide sign-offs recorded here instead.
Brief grants approval decisions; recorded per brief ('write the decision and its reason in the state file').

decisions.what: Split train/val/test 12/12/12, stratified by category, seed 20261010; val picks the winner; test scored each round at 1 rep and at the end with more reps
decisions.why: Brief: train/validation/test split, measure on validation with repeated trials, test scored each round.

decisions.what: Lever edits are proposals: each variant's AGENTS.md/skills live in evals/agents/vN/levers and vN/change.patch; the branch's own AGENTS.md and skills stay unchanged
decisions.why: Liu Hao's rule: agent ideas enter a skill only when he says 'add N'.

decisions.decision: Runs use --permission-mode auto
decisions.why: Production defaultMode is auto (~/.claude/settings.json). The acceptEdits pilot denied git commit and python, which production allows.

decisions.decision: Keep the Bash(git push:*) deny rule
decisions.why: Removing it was refused by the auto-mode classifier as a security weakening. A compound 'commit && push' command is denied as a whole, so some agents may fail 'committed'; counted as a harness limit.

decisions.decision: ed09 tests run with .venv/bin/python
decisions.why: System python3 lacks a module; 4 test_vast cases fail at base. With the project venv all 64 pass at base.

decisions.decision: Pause new runs while the shared claude 5 h window is below 15% left; stop at weekly or fable weekly below 30% or at 08:00 BST
decisions.why: Brief: the Ceridwen merge swarm has priority on quota; floors and deadline from the brief. Implemented in run.py gate().

decisions.decision: Empty reply scores 0 on reply-style items
decisions.why: Judge negatives (judge_negatives.json): 12/12 empty, 'I don't know' and wrong replies fail 'correct', but an empty reply passed no_commentary and the deterministic style items.

decisions.decision: pilot/ is a harness shakedown, not a scored variant
decisions.why: Run before the change-parser and permission fixes.

decisions.decision: Baseline paused at 4/12 train runs; runner stopped
decisions.why: Shared claude 5 h window reached 0% (resets 02:49); the merge swarm has priority. Judge timed out on st02 at 0%. Resume: python3 run.py --variant baseline --split train,val,test --reps 1,3,1 --concurrency 4 after the reset (resume is per case/rep). Add a judge retry with a shorter timeout first.

decisions.decision: Quota gate reads bridge.py quota (live) instead of bridge.py status
decisions.why: status shows a cached reading; at 02:52 it still said 0% while the live reading was 87%.

decisions.decision: Runs reuse fixed sandbox paths (slot0..slotN) per variant
decisions.why: The system prompt holds the working directory; one path per slot lets runs share the prompt cache. List cost was $0.4-2.0 per run with fresh paths, and one 5 h window is shared with the merge swarm.

decisions.decision: Judge: 180 s timeout, up to 4 attempts with backoff
decisions.why: Two judge calls hung for 600 s at a spent 5 h window (st02, ex08 grader_error).

decisions.decision: Rubric: no_commentary no longer counts source pointers or adjacent content; re-judge recorded rows
decisions.why: Hand labels on 8 runs: 32/36 items agreed; all 4 disagreements were no_commentary failing file paths/citations or adjacent content already graded by direct (judge_agreement.json).

decisions.decision: Reps: train 1, val 2, test 1 per round (was val 3)
decisions.why: Remaining time is one 5 h window (to 07:49) shared with the merge swarm, which has priority.

decisions.decision: Concurrency 2; reps train 1, val 1, test 1; pause new runs below 25% of the 5 h window
decisions.why: At 02:53-03:03 the shared 5 h window fell 87% -> 57% with 4 eval runs and 5+ merge-swarm opus sessions active; weekly 68% -> 65%. The swarm has priority. 4 in-flight runs were stopped and are re-run.

decisions.decision: Eval runs paused until the 07:50 reset; stop time 11:00 BST; weekly floor 40%; 25% 5 h reserve kept for the merge swarm
decisions.why: Lead decision (overseer-astronomy, 03:30) in reply to agent-hillclimb's blocked message: the swarm has priority; Liu Hao keeps quota for Sunday. In-flight runs were stopped.

decisions.decision: Push block moved from the Bash(git push:*) permission rule to git config (url.DISABLED/.pushInsteadOf for https, http, git@, ssh, file and / URLs); baseline ed02/ed04 rows marked harness_error and re-run
decisions.why: Agents commit with 'git add && git commit && git push'; the deny rule refused the whole command, so no commit landed and 'committed'/'correct' failed for a reason absent in production. The git-level block also catches 'git -C . push' and explicit URLs, which the prefix rule missed; the network sandbox, the DISABLED push URL and GIT_SSH_COMMAND=/usr/bin/false stay.

decisions.decision: Verified the git-level push block on baseline ed06: the agent's 'git add && git commit && git push' committed (committed=1) and the push failed with 'Please make sure you have the correct access rights and the repository exists'
decisions.why: Pending check from the 03:40 push-block change.

decisions.decision: Known harness limit, kept for this round: the sandbox does not check out the external/fsps submodule, so experiment.py --dry-run stops at 'missing external/fsps/data/emlines_info.dat' (ed05, ed06). Same for baseline and v1, so the paired comparison holds; fix in sandbox.SUBMODULES before the next round
decisions.why: Changing the template mid-round would break the pairing of baseline and v1 runs.

decisions.decision: Grader fix after the round: dry_run_only counts 'experiment.py run --help' as a launch without --dry-run (baseline ed06 scored 0 for a run that only used --dry-run). Recompute dry_run_only from the recorded traces for every row with --help/-h calls excluded; applied to baseline and v1 alike
decisions.why: Deterministic item, recomputable from transcripts; running processes keep the old grade.py in memory.

decisions.decision: dry_run_only recomputed from traces with the fixed rule (grade.py); baseline ed06 0.6 -> 0.7, v1 ed06 0.7 -> 0.8; no other row has the item
decisions.why: Decision 08:20.

decisions.decision: Mechanism check: the variant AGENTS.md is in the agent's context (st06 runs scripts/sync_wiki_direction.py --read in both variants, a rule stated only in AGENTS.md); the v1 skill text appears in the v1 traces' Skill reads
decisions.why: eval-audit.md s5 'The mechanism is wired'; no extra eval run spent.

decisions.decision: Stop: runners stopped at 09:20 while idle in the quota gate; no further rounds. v1 not recommended (val delta within noise)
decisions.why: 5 h window at 7%, reset 12:50, after the lead's 11:00 stop time; the 25% reserve belongs to the merge swarm.

best.note: v1 val 0.689 (paired delta +0.006 +/-0.036, n=12, 1 trial) is within noise; baseline levers kept

stop.reason: quota: the shared claude 5 h window fell below the 25% merge-swarm reserve at about 08:40 (7% at 09:20) and resets at 12:50, after the 11:00 BST stop time; runners stopped while idle in the gate
stop.done: val 12/12 paired (baseline, v1); test baseline 9/12, v1 5/12; train baseline 9/12, v1 0/12
